title: Issuer Stress Testing Program Services
agency: HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, DEPARTMENT OF > HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, DEPARTMENT OF > CPO : GNMA SUPPORT DIVISION
description: The Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), Ginnie Mae Office of Enterprise Risk (OER) has a requirement for Issuer Stress Testing program services. The purpose of this requirement is to obtain contractor support services with expertise to produce comprehensive analyses, insights, reports, white papers, power point presentations and data covering US housing and mortgage finance ecosystems.
